findings.description: The KMS key does not have automatic key rotation enabled (enable_key_rotation is not set to true), which means the same cryptographic key material is used indefinitely, increasing the risk if the key is ever compromised and weakening cryptographic hygiene for data encrypted at rest.

No key_policy is defined for the KMS key, so it falls back to the default policy granting full access (kms:*) to the root account, which can be overly permissive depending on IAM configuration and violates least privilege for key usage and management.
